generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for

Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical Contractor License issued from Inspectorate of Electricity.
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate

Tenderer in their name should submit annual turnover certificate any two years from last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs.2.15 Lakhs in each year. Turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka /any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU. The bidder should submit self declaration for the same.

itemList.description:
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS OF WASHING MACHINE (COMMERCIAL):
Front Loading Washing Machine with Loading Capacity of 6 Kg. Dry Weight Per Charge, Open Pocket, Heavy Duty, Steam Heated, Inner Basket And Outer Drum Stainless Steel, Microcontroller based Controller for fully automatic programs, Consists of Auto Timed, Auto Reverse Forward, Auto Digital Temperature Control, Water level control. Auto Drain Valve. Large LCD display for clear visibility of status of machine, Wash Motor coordinate with Pulleys and V-Belts to create the positive drive Complete With Control Panel, Stainless steel Front, Door & Hopper
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS OF WASHING MACHINE:
1.	Front loading/top loading type fully automatic system to washing machine to wash different type of fabric with dryer extractor
2.	The system shall have pre-set program for different type of fabric
3.	The system shall be have inbuilt heater system to hot water rinse and wash
4.	The system shall be open ended system to for usage of detergent / Disinfectant
5.	The system should be capable working on low water pressure\
6.	The system shall have Drum made up of SS
7.	Capacity range from 6kg to 8kg
8.	The Washing machine can be a direct drive or Belt driven Induction motor
9.	The machine shall be able function al single phase 220V +/-12V
10.	The Machine shall be 3 to 5 star rating of BIS
11.	The Machine shall carry a comprehensive warranty of 5 years including motor
12.	The machine shall be appropriate drain system Fixture to connect to the drain
13.	The Machine shall have all safety features including stop operation if door is opened
14.	The System shall have visual and auditable system for mode selection, Completion of cycle, error, etc.
15.	The system shall be supplied with floor Surface adjustable stand

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS OF REFRIGERATOR (180-200) LTRS COMMERCIAL
1.	Minimum Gross storage Capacity: 180 to 200 ltrs
2.	Model Type: Single door
3.	Voltage Range at 40 degree centigrade : Capable of working on 220 volts +/-12% AC 50Hz
4.	Power Source: AC, 220 Volts to, 50 Hz
5.	Method of Defrosting: Frost Free
6.	Insulation: Puff/Maxi 2/Polyurethane
7.	Refrigerant Gas: CFC free
8.	Compressor: Power saver compressor
9.	Accessories Require : Adjustable shelves, chiller Tray. Temperature controller. Auto lamp On/off feature, should be supplied with all standard accessories as per manufacturer catalogue for the model supplied.
10.	Warranty: 5 year Comprehensive Warranty 
11.	Stabilizer: Should be supplied with 0.5 KVA capacities CVT without any extra cost. The CVT will also carry 5 years warranty.
12.	Colours: Steel grey with metallic finish (Metallic Colour).
13.	Power Rating: 3/5 Star rating.
14.	Certificate: BIS
